$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. Object3dJob per docs/design/objects-3d.md §5/§6 ('job lifecycle: dev.fonebrew.domain.object3d.Object3dJob.kt state machine (QUEUED->RUNNING->DOWNLOADING->DONE/FAILED), tested' and 'object3d-job.schema.json (cloud job envelope)'). Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<Object3dJob> (schemas/common/envelope.schema.json). Every Object3dJob is, by construction, a watched-cloud operation (binding rule 2) — there is no on-device variant of this schema because the on-device path (§4) never leaves the device and has no async job to track.
title: Object3dJob
description: One async cloud 3D-generation job against Meshy or Tripo (§5): create -> poll -> download. `downloadUrl` is checked for SHAPE only by this schema (`format: uri`) — that its host is actually the declared `provider`'s own infrastructure, not an unrelated or look-alike host, is an application-level check (dev.fonebrew.domain.object3d.CloudObject3dContracts.validateDownloadUrl), same split schemas/loops/loop-release.schema.json's `releaseAssetUrl` documents for the identical class of gap. See fixtures/object3d/adversarial/ for the fixture that is structurally valid here but MUST be refused by that real check.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this record's shape. A reader MUST reject an unrecognized MAJOR.

jobId.description: Globally unique stable id for this job record (this app's own id, not the provider's).

provider.description: §5: 'adapters for Meshy and Tripo'. Unlike Object3dNode.provider, CUSTOM is deliberately not a legal value here — a job is always dispatched against one of the two adapters this schema's sibling CloudObject3dContracts.kt implements; a custom base-URL escape hatch (§1) still has to declare which of the two wire protocols it speaks, which is a CloudObject3dContracts.textTo3dCreate/imageTo3dCreate constructor-time choice, not a third job-schema value.

providerJobId.description: The vendor's own job/task id, returned from the create call and used for every subsequent poll (§5: 'async job -> poll -> download').

prompt.description: Required non-blank when mode=TEXT_TO_3D; null when mode=IMAGE_TO_3D (see allOf).

sourceImageRef.description: Reference to the source image artifact when mode=IMAGE_TO_3D — required non-blank in that case, null for TEXT_TO_3D (see allOf). Deliberately a bare reference string (not an inline ArtifactRef) since the image itself is dev.fonebrew.domain.image's object, not this domain's.

progressPercent.description: Provider-reported progress, when available. Null before the provider reports any, or for a provider that only reports coarse state.

downloadUrl.description: Required non-null when state is DOWNLOADING or DONE; null otherwise (see allOf). See this schema's top-level $comment — shape-checked only here.

resultNodeId.description: References the Object3dNode.nodeId (object3d-node.schema.json) minted once the downloaded bytes are written to app storage. Required non-null exactly when state=DONE (see allOf); null otherwise — a job is not DONE until the file exists and its node is minted, never DONE-with-no-node.

errorEnvelope.description: Reused as-is from schemas/common/error.schema.json. Required non-null when state=FAILED (see allOf); null otherwise.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant this job record was first created (the create-call dispatch time).

updatedAtUtc.description: UTC instant `state` (or progress) last changed. MUST be >= createdAtUtc.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip.

allOf.$comment: Mirrors schemas/devices/operation.schema.json's state-conditional if/then discipline: DOWNLOADING/DONE structurally imply the URL that made the transition possible actually exists.

Object3dJobState.description: §5/§6, verbatim. Non-terminal: QUEUED, RUNNING, DOWNLOADING. Terminal: DONE, FAILED. This single-snapshot schema enumerates the valid values but (like schemas/execution/handle.schema.json's ExecutionState) cannot itself enforce that a transition BETWEEN two snapshots followed a legal edge — that is dev.fonebrew.domain.object3d.Object3dJobMachine's job (the Kotlin sealed-interface encoding), mirroring dev.fonebrew.domain.device.broker.DeviceOperationMachine's own split between this JSON-Schema-visible enum and the real transition law.
